Title: Add gallery and media management (photos & albums)

Description:
Implement gallery support to upload photos, create albums, and attach photos to events/projects.

Acceptance criteria:
- `Photo` and `Album` models with upload and caption support.
- API endpoints to upload images and list albums/photos.
- Frontend pages to view gallery and event-linked albums.

Notes:
- Use image processing/resizing (e.g., Pillow) for thumbnails.

Priority: Low
